==Goals==
* Metrics ''in service of improving wikis and online information''
* Understand what is cited in Wikipedia and where
* Build a chain of provenance from Wikipedia to Wikipedia's sources to the sources' sources

==Adding projects to this list==
Your project does not need to be developed by Scatter LLC to be on this list if it is open source and furthers the above stated goals. The goals of this project require extensive collaboration.
